title: Heaven2madness - Old News
htmlContent:
Heaven2madness's "Old News" is a soulful piece of Hip Hop art that you can take with you, and enjoy the lessons and blessings in the record. His talents shine, and his lessons shines brighter, while he delivers a classic Hip Hop performance for people all over the world to enjoy, as well as give you every reason to check out his new project.

His presence is commanding, over this production that packed with super flow is on full bloom for the world to enjoy. The flow isn’t the only that marvels but the lyrics as well as he shows off his incredible pen, that will be sure to build a discography of must hear hits.
